about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Crisp-Skin Soy Glazed Roast Chicken
recipes.summary: A whole chicken dried, glazed with soy and honey and roasted until the skin crackles.
steps: Pat the chicken very dry, then rub the salt and five spice inside and out. Stuff the cavity with the spring onion and ginger.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, wine and vinegar, brush a first coat over the skin and leave uncovered in the fridge to dry the skin.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the chicken on a rack for 25 minutes, then brush with more glaze.
Lower the oven to 180°C and roast for 45 minutes more, glazing twice, until the skin is deep mahogany and crisp.
Check the thickest part of the thigh reads 75°C, then rest the chicken for 15 minutes before carving.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and serve with the carved chicken and the pan juices.
notes: Food safety: the thickest part of the thigh must reach 75°C and the juices run clear. Plus 3 hours drying in the fridge.

recipes.title: Hand-Torn Noodles with Braised Beef Shin
recipes.summary: Chewy hand-torn dough ribbons tossed through tender soy-braised beef shin and bok choy.
steps: Brown the beef in 1 tbsp of the oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until deeply coloured, then set aside.
Fry the ginger, garlic, star anise and doubanjiang in the pot for 1 minute until fragrant, then return the beef.
Add both soy sauces, the wine and 3 cups of water. Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours until the beef is fork-tender.
Knead the flour with 1 cup of water for 8 minutes until smooth, rub with the remaining oil, cover and rest.
Roll the dough out thin, tear into postcard-sized pieces and boil in a large pot of water for 3 minutes until they float and are chewy.
Add the bok choy to the braise for the last 2 minutes, then toss the noodles through the beef and sauce.
Serve topped with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: braise the beef until it is very tender and reads at least 75°C in the centre. Plus 30 minutes resting the dough.

recipes.title: Prawn and Avocado Sushi Roll Platter
recipes.summary: Hand-rolled maki and inside-out rolls of cooked prawn, avocado, cucumber and sweet omelette.
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, cook it with the lid on until tender, then rest for 10 minutes.
Warm the vinegar, sugar and salt until dissolved, fold through the hot rice and fan until cooled to room temperature.
Beat the eggs with the mirin and cook as a thin omelette in a lightly oiled pan over low heat until just set, then slice into strips.
Lay a nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread with a thin layer of rice and add a line of prawn, avocado, cucumber or omelette.
Roll tightly, wet the edge to seal, and make 6 rolls. For two of them, roll the rice outside and coat in sesame seed.
Cut each roll into 8 with a wet sharp knife and serve with soy sauce, pickled ginger and wasabi.
notes: Food safety: use pre-cooked prawns kept chilled, and eat the rolls the same day. The omelette is cooked until fully set.

recipes.title: Bossam-Style Pork Belly Wraps with Kimchi
recipes.summary: Gently simmered pork belly sliced thin and wrapped in lettuce with ssamjang and kimchi.

items: 2 spring onion, cut into thin strips

steps: Put the pork, onion, ginger, garlic, miso paste, soy sauce and sugar in a pot and cover with water by 3cm.
Bring to the boil, then simmer gently for 90 minutes until a skewer slides easily through the pork.
Lift the pork out and rest for 15 minutes, then slice it into 5mm pieces.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender.
Serve the pork with lettuce leaves, rice, ssamjang, kimchi and spring onion so everyone can build their own wraps.
notes: Food safety: the pork is cooked once it reaches 75°C in the thickest part and is tender throughout. Plus 15 minutes resting.

recipes.title: Lamb Biryani Layered Dum Pot
recipes.summary: Marinated lamb and saffron rice layered with fried onion and mint, then sealed and steamed on low heat.
steps: Mix the lamb with the yoghurt, ginger garlic paste, garam masala, turmeric, chilli powder and 1 tsp salt, and leave to marinate.
Fry the onion in the oil over medium heat for 15 minutes until deep golden and crisp, then lift out and set half aside.
Soak the rice for 20 minutes, then parboil with the clove, cardamom, cinnamon and remaining salt for 5 minutes until almost cooked, and drain.
Warm the milk and steep the saffron in it. Layer the lamb and its marinade in a heavy pot, add half the onion, the mint and coriander.
Cover with the rice, drizzle with saffron milk and scatter with the reserved onion.
Seal the pot tightly with foil and a lid, cook on the lowest heat for 60 minutes until the lamb is tender.
Rest for 10 minutes, then gently fold from the bottom and serve.
notes: Food safety: the lamb should be tender and reach at least 70°C in the centre of the largest piece. Plus 4 hours marinating.

recipes.title: Crispy Fish with Sweet Sour Chilli Sauce
recipes.summary: Cornflour-dusted fish fillets fried until crisp and glazed with a tangy sweet chilli sauce.
steps: Pat the fish very dry, season with the salt and press into the cornflour until evenly coated.
Heat the oil in a wide pan to 180°C and fry the fish for 4 minutes each side until golden, crisp and the flesh flakes easily.
Drain on a rack, then pour off all but 1 tbsp of oil from the pan.
Fry the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds, add the sweet chilli sauce, fish sauce and lime juice and bubble for 2 minutes until glossy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Spoon the sauce over the fish and serve with coriander, cucumber and rice.
notes: Food safety: the fish is cooked when the flesh turns opaque and flakes easily with a fork.

recipes.title: Banh Xeo Turmeric Crepes with Prawn
recipes.summary: Crisp coconut turmeric crepes folded around prawns, sprouts and herbs, wrapped in lettuce to eat.
steps: Whisk the rice flour, turmeric, coconut milk, water and spring onion into a thin batter and rest.
Fry the pork mince in a little oil over high heat for 4 minutes until browned and cooked through, then add the prawns for 2 minutes until pink and opaque.
Heat a non-stick pan with a spoonful of oil until very hot, pour in a ladle of batter and swirl thin.
Add a spoonful of the prawn and pork mix and a handful of sprouts, cover for 2 minutes, then uncover until the edge is crisp and golden.
Fold the crepe in half and repeat for 8 crepes in total.
Stir the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, garlic and 2 tbsp water until the sugar dissolves, and serve for dipping with lettuce and mint.
notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C throughout and prawns turn opaque and pink before serving. Plus 30 minutes resting the batter.

recipes.title: Balinese Spiced Duck Leg Bake
recipes.summary: Duck legs rubbed with turmeric, lemongrass and chilli paste and slow-roasted until the skin crisps.
steps: Blitz the shallot, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, chilli, turmeric, coriander seed, salt and oil into a smooth paste.
Rub the paste over the duck legs, tuck the lime leaves underneath and leave to marinate.
Heat the oven to 160°C. Roast the duck legs skin side up in a snug dish, covered with foil, for 90 minutes until very tender.
Remove the foil, brush with kecap manis and roast at 200°C for 15 minutes until the skin is dark and crisp.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the duck and cucumber.
notes: Food safety: duck is done when the thickest part of the leg reaches 75°C and the meat pulls away from the bone. Plus 2 hours marinating.

recipes.title: Nasi Lemak Plates with Sambal Chicken
recipes.summary: Coconut rice with sambal-glazed chicken, a fried egg, cucumber and crunchy peanuts.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it with the coconut milk, water, lemongrass and a pinch of salt, covered, until tender and fluffy.
Fry the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then add the sambal oelek, tamarind and palm sugar and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and 1/4 cup water, cover and cook for 20 minutes, turning, until the sauce is thick and sticky.
Toast the peanuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden, then fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set.
Plate the rice with chicken, an egg, cucumber, peanuts and fried shallots.
notes: Food safety: chicken thigh must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink juices.

recipes.title: Crisp Pork Belly with Garlic Vinegar Dip
recipes.summary: Pork belly simmered, dried and fried until the crackling shatters, served with a sharp garlic vinegar dip.
steps: Simmer the pork with the onion, peppercorns, bay leaves and salt in water for 60 minutes until a skewer slides in easily.
Lift out the pork, pat very dry and leave uncovered in the fridge so the skin dries out completely.
Cut into thick slabs and shallow-fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes each side until the skin blisters and turns crisp.
Stir the vinegar, garlic, chilli and sugar together with a pinch of salt for the dip.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and serve with the pork and dip.
notes: Food safety: the pork is cooked once it reaches 75°C in the thickest part. Hot oil spits, so keep the skin very dry. Plus 3 hours drying in the fridge.

recipes.title: Swahili Chicken Pilau
recipes.summary: Spiced rice cooked in a rich stock with caramelised onion and tender chicken pieces.
steps: Brown the onion in the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat for 15 minutes until deep brown, stirring often.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin seed, cinnamon, cardamom, pepper and turmeric and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and tomato and cook for 10 minutes until the chicken is browned and the tomato breaks down.
Stir in the rinsed rice, stock and salt, bring to the boil, then cover and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes until the rice is tender.
Rest for 10 minutes with the lid on, then fluff with a fork and serve.
notes: Food safety: the thickest part of the chicken must reach 75°C and the juices run clear.

recipes.title: Apricot-Spiced Lamb Curry with Potato
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked lamb in a mildly sweet, fragrant curry with apricot, finished with fresh coriander.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in a heavy pot over high heat for 8 minutes until deeply coloured, then lift out.
Soften the onion in the same pot for 8 minutes, add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, turmeric and cinnamon and stir for 1 minute.
Return the lamb with the tomatoes, apricot, sugar, tamarind and water, cover and simmer gently for 60 minutes.
Add the potato and cook for 30 minutes more until the lamb is fork-tender and the sauce is thick.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then stir the coriander through the curry and serve.
notes: Food safety: the lamb should be tender and reach at least 70°C in the centre of the largest piece.

recipes.title: Kalua-Style Slow Pork Shoulder with Rice
recipes.summary: Smoky, salty pulled pork cooked low and slow in the oven, served over rice with pineapple.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C. Rub the pork all over with the salt, smoked paprika and soy sauce.
Place in a deep roasting dish with the water, cover tightly with foil and roast for 4 hours until the meat falls apart.
Check the centre reads 90°C or more, then rest for 15 minutes before shredding with two forks.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and mix a few spoonfuls of the pan juices through the shredded pork.
Serve the pork over rice with pineapple and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 75°C in the centre; for pulling it should reach 90°C and be fork-tender.

recipes.title: Fijian-Style Coconut Chicken Foil Parcels
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs steamed in foil parcels with coconut cream, spinach, ginger and chilli.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and cut four large squares of foil.
Toss the chicken with the coconut cream, ginger, garlic, chilli, lime juice and salt.
Pile the spinach and onion in the centre of each square, top with the chicken and sauce, and fold the foil into sealed parcels.
Bake on a tray for 35 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the spinach is soft.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve the parcels opened over rice.
notes: Food safety: open one parcel to check the chicken has reached 75°C with no pink juices.

recipes.title: Samoan-Style Coconut Fish with Rice
recipes.summary: Pan-seared fish simmered in coconut milk with lime and spring onion, served over steamed rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, then pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Slide in the fish, add the salt and tomato, and cook gently for 8 minutes until the flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
Stir through the lime juice and half the spring onion.
Spoon over the rice and finish with the remaining spring onion.
notes: Food safety: the fish is cooked when it turns opaque and flakes with a fork.

recipes.title: Pacific Pumpkin Coconut Bake with Spinach
recipes.summary: Sweet pumpkin baked in coconut milk with ginger and lime, finished with wilted spinach and peanuts.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the pumpkin with the oil, turmeric and salt in a baking dish.
Roast for 20 minutes until the edges are starting to brown.
Stir through the onion, ginger, garlic and coconut milk and bake for 20 minutes more until the pumpkin is tender.
Fold the spinach through until wilted, and squeeze over the lime juice.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the bake and peanuts.

recipes.title: Nyama Choma-Style Beef Skewers
recipes.summary: Chilli and garlic marinated beef sirloin skewers charred and served with tomato onion relish and rice.
steps: Mix the beef with the garlic, ginger, oil, chilli powder, cumin, half the lemon juice and the salt, and leave to marinate.
Mix the tomato, red onion, coriander, green chilli and remaining lemon juice for the relish.
Thread the beef onto skewers and grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred outside and cooked to your liking.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve the skewers with the relish and rice.
notes: Food safety: beef cubes should reach 63°C internal for medium or 71°C for well done; rest for 3 minutes before serving. Plus 2 hours marinating.

recipes.title: Kenyan Coconut Chicken Curry
recipes.summary: Chicken simmered in a tomato and coconut curry with ginger and green chilli, served with chapati-style flatbread.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil over medium heat for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the tomato and cook for 5 minutes until broken down.
Add the chicken, coconut milk, chilli and salt, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir through the coriander and serve with warm flatbread.
notes: Food safety: the thickest piece of chicken must reach 75°C with no pink juices.

recipes.title: Ethiopian-Style Red Lentil Stew with Flatbread
recipes.summary: A spiced red lentil stew with onion, garlic and berbere-style spices, scooped up with warm flatbread.
steps: Cook the onion in a dry pot over medium heat for 8 minutes until softened, then add the oil, garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the paprika, chilli powder, cumin, coriander, cinnamon and tomato paste for 1 minute until dark and fragrant.
Add the rinsed lentils, water and salt, bring to the boil, then simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are soft and the stew is thick.
Serve in bowls with warm flatbread for scooping.

recipes.title: Bobotie Baked Curried Mince
recipes.summary: Spiced beef mince with apricot and almond under a golden egg custard, served with rice.

items: 1 slice white bread, soaked in milk

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, curry powder and turmeric and stir for 1 minute.
Add the mince and cook for 8 minutes until browned, breaking up lumps, then stir in the jam, sultana, almond, squeezed bread and salt.
Press the mince into a baking dish. Whisk the eggs with the milk and pour over, then lay the bay leaves on top.
Bake for 30 minutes until the custard is set and golden.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the bobotie.
notes: Food safety: the mince must reach 75°C throughout and the egg topping must be fully set.

recipes.title: Peri-Peri Chicken Thighs with Pap-Style Polenta
recipes.summary: Chilli lemon grilled chicken thighs beside creamy maize porridge and a quick tomato relish.
steps: Blend the chilli, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, paprika and half the salt, and coat the chicken in it.
Heat the oven to 220°C and roast the chicken on a tray for 30 minutes until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Bring the water and remaining salt to the boil, whisk in the polenta and cook on low heat for 15 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy, then beat in the butter.
Mix the tomato and red onion with a pinch of salt for the relish.
Serve the chicken over the polenta with the relish.
notes: Food safety: the thickest part of the chicken must reach 75°C with no pink juices. Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Butternut and Bean Potjie
recipes.summary: A one-pot stew of butternut, beans and tomato with warm curry spices, simmered until thick.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat for 6 minutes, then stir in the garlic, curry powder and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the pumpkin, carrot, tomatoes, stock, jam and salt, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the beans and cook for 8 minutes more until heated through and the sauce is thick.
Scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.
notes: Dinner. Vegan. Use canned beans only; if cooking dried kidney beans, boil them hard for 10 minutes first.

recipes.title: Kung Pao Tofu with Cashews
recipes.summary: Crisp tofu cubes tossed in a glossy sweet-sour chilli sauce with cashews, capsicum and Sichuan pepper.
steps: Toss the tofu in the cornflour, then fry in 2 tbsp of the oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp. Lift out.
Toast the cashews in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden.
Stir the soy sauce, vinegar and sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Fry the dried chilli and peppercorns in the remaining oil for 30 seconds, then add the garlic and capsicum and stir-fry for 3 minutes until just tender.
Return the tofu and cashews, pour in the sauce and toss for 2 minutes until sticky.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve topped with spring onion.

recipes.title: Vegetable Katsu Curry Plates
recipes.summary: Crumbed pumpkin and eggplant cutlets with a mild sweet curry sauce over rice.
steps: Whisk the flour and water into a thin batter. Dip the pumpkin and eggplant in it, then press into the panko.
Soften the onion and carrot in 1 tbsp oil for 6 minutes, stir in the curry powder and flour for 1 minute, then add the stock, soy sauce and sugar.
Simmer the sauce for 15 minutes until thick, then blend smooth if you like.
Shallow-fry the cutlets in the remaining oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until golden and the pumpkin is tender.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then top with the cutlets and spoon over the sauce.

recipes.title: Mushroom Bibimbap Bowls
recipes.summary: Rice topped with sauteed mushrooms, carrot, spinach and crisp tofu, finished with a gochujang sauce.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Fry the tofu in 1 tbsp neutral oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until golden on all sides, then set aside.
Saute the mushrooms in the remaining neutral oil with half the garlic for 6 minutes until browned, then season with the soy sauce.
Quickly cook the carrot in a hot pan for 2 minutes until just tender, and wilt the spinach with the rest of the garlic and a little sesame oil.
Stir the gochujang with the vinegar, remaining sesame oil and 1 tbsp water.
Divide the rice between bowls, arrange the vegetables, tofu and cucumber on top, and finish with the sauce and sesame seed.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Red Curry with Rice
recipes.summary: Soft pumpkin and green beans in a creamy coconut red curry with lime and basil.
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil in a large pot over medium heat for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock, add the soy sauce and palm sugar, and bring to a gentle simmer until bubbling.
Add the pumpkin and cook for 15 minutes until almost tender, then add the beans for 5 minutes until just cooked.
Stir through the lime juice and basil.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the curry.
notes: Dinner. Vegan. Check the curry paste label if you avoid shrimp paste.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Tofu Vermicelli Bowls
recipes.summary: Lemongrass-marinated tofu over rice vermicelli with crunchy vegetables, herbs and peanuts.
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, soy sauce and half the sugar, and coat the tofu in it.
Soak or boil the vermicelli according to the packet until tender, then drain and rinse in cold water.
Pan-fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes each side until golden and caramelised.
Stir the lime juice, vinegar and remaining sugar with 2 tbsp water until the sugar dissolves.
Divide the noodles between bowls, top with the vegetables, mint and tofu, and drizzle with the dressing and peanuts.

recipes.title: Sambal Tofu Stir-Fry with Green Beans
recipes.summary: Tofu and green beans wok-tossed in a fiery tamarind sambal, served on rice.
steps: Fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until golden all over, then lift out.
Fry the onion and garlic in the remaining oil for 4 minutes until soft, then add the sambal oelek, tamarind, kecap manis and palm sugar.
Add the beans and water and stir-fry for 5 minutes until the beans are tender-crisp.
Return the tofu and toss for 2 minutes until coated in the thick sauce.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve the stir-fry on top.
notes: Dinner. Vegan. Check the label of the kecap manis if you avoid fish products.

recipes.title: Mushroom Rendang with Coconut Rice
recipes.summary: Meaty mushrooms simmered in a dry coconut rendang paste until dark and sticky.
steps: Blitz the shallot, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, chilli and turmeric into a paste.
Toast the desiccated coconut in a dry pan for 3 minutes until deep golden, then grind it roughly.
Fry the paste in the oil in a wide pan over medium heat for 8 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the mushrooms, coconut milk, tamarind, sugar and salt and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring, until the sauce is thick and clinging to the mushrooms.
Stir through the toasted coconut. Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and serve alongside.

recipes.title: Mushroom Adobo Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Mushrooms braised in a soy, vinegar and garlic adobo sauce until glossy, served over rice.
steps: Fry the mushrooms in the oil in a wide pot over high heat for 8 minutes until browned and their liquid has gone.
Add the garlic, bay leaves and pepper and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and water and simmer for 15 minutes without stirring for the first 5 minutes until the sauce is reduced and glossy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender.
Spoon the mushrooms and sauce over the rice and top with spring onion.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Cashew and Pea Curry
recipes.summary: Creamy cashews and peas in a mild coconut curry with curry leaves, mustard seed and turmeric.
steps: Soak the cashews in hot water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat the coconut oil, add the mustard seed and curry leaves and cook for 30 seconds until they pop.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry powder, turmeric and cinnamon.
Add the cashews, coconut milk, water and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the cashews are tender, then add the peas for 3 minutes until bright.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the curry.
notes: Dinner. Vegan. Plus 20 minutes soaking the cashews.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Spinach Curry with Jeera Rice
recipes.summary: Chickpeas and spinach in a lightly spiced tomato curry, served with cumin-scented rice.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, garam masala, turmeric and ground cumin and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and salt, and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Stir in the chickpeas and cook for 8 minutes, then fold in the spinach until wilted.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, stirring the cumin seed through at the end.
Serve the curry over the rice.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice Flour Cake
recipes.summary: A tender, lightly sweet gluten-free cake made with rice flour and coconut milk.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 20cm cake tin.
Whisk the eggs and sugar for 4 minutes until pale and thick, then whisk in the coconut milk, coconut oil and vanilla.
Fold in the rice flour, baking powder and desiccated coconut until just combined.
Pour into the tin and bake for 35 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes before turning out.

recipes.title: Cardamom Almond Cake
recipes.summary: A moist gluten-free almond cake scented with cardamom and finished with a honey glaze.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 20cm cake tin.
Beat the eggs and sugar for 3 minutes until pale, then stir in the butter and cardamom.
Fold in the almond meal and baking powder until smooth.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean, then brush with honey and scatter with pistachio.
Cool completely in the tin before slicing.

recipes.title: Besan Shortbread Rounds
recipes.summary: Crumbly gluten-free shortbread made with chickpea flour, cardamom and ghee.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C and line a tray.
Beat the ghee and icing sugar for 3 minutes until pale, then mix in the chickpea flour and cardamom to a soft dough.
Roll into 12 balls, flatten gently and press a few pistachio into each.
Bake for 18 minutes until firm and just golden at the edges.
Cool completely on the tray as they crisp up.

recipes.title: Flourless Peanut Butter Cookies
recipes.summary: Chewy, three-ingredient style cookies with peanut butter, sugar and egg and a pinch of salt.
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C and line two trays.
Mix the peanut butter, sugar, egg, bicarbonate of soda and salt until a thick dough forms.
Roll into 12 balls, press onto the trays and top with chopped peanuts.
Bake for 11 minutes until puffed and golden at the edges, then cool on the tray.

recipes.title: Cassava Coconut Brownies
recipes.summary: Dense chocolatey gluten-free brownies made with cassava flour and coconut sugar-free sweetness from brown sugar.
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a 20cm tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter together gently, then stir in the sugar and eggs one at a time until glossy.
Fold in the cassava flour, cocoa, coconut and salt until just combined.
Bake for 22 minutes until the top is set and a skewer comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the tin before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Black Sesame Rice Flour Muffins
recipes.summary: Nutty gluten-free muffins with ground black sesame and a soft crumb.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line 8 muffin cups.
Toast the sesame in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant, then grind coarsely.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, milk, oil and vanilla, then fold in the rice flour, sesame and baking powder until just combined.
Divide between the cups and bake for 20 minutes until risen and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool on a wire rack before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Almond Brownies
recipes.summary: Fudgy gluten-free squares with mashed sweet potato, almond meal and cocoa.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 20cm tin.
Whisk the mashed sweet potato, maple syrup, eggs and coconut oil until smooth.
Fold in the almond meal, cocoa and baking powder, then the chocolate.
Bake for 28 minutes until set and a skewer comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool completely before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Thai Rice Flour Coconut Custard Cakes
recipes.summary: Little crisp-edged coconut rice cakes with a creamy centre, made in a hot pan or muffin tin.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and brush a 12-hole mini muffin tin with coconut oil.
Whisk the rice flour, coconut milk, sugar and salt into a smooth batter, then stir in the corn and spring onion.
Heat the greased tin in the oven for 5 minutes until very hot.
Fill each hole with batter and bake for 15 minutes until set with golden edges.
Lift out gently and serve warm.

recipes.title: Spring Onion Egg Pancake Rolls
recipes.summary: Thin savoury pancakes cooked with a layer of egg and spring onion, rolled and cut into pinwheels.
steps: Whisk the flour, water and salt into a smooth thin batter, and beat the eggs with the spring onion.
Heat a little oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in half the batter, swirling thin.
Cook for 1 minute until set, pour half the egg mixture over the top and cook for 2 minutes until the egg is fully set, then roll up.
Repeat with the rest, brush with sesame oil and cut into pinwheels.
Serve with the soy sauce for dipping.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Jianbing-Style Egg Crepe Wraps
recipes.summary: A thin crepe cooked with egg, sesame and spring onion, then wrapped around a crisp wonton cracker and sauce.
steps: Whisk the flours and water into a thin batter and rest briefly.
Fry the wonton wrappers in the oil over medium heat for 1 minute each side until golden and crisp, then drain.
Pour half the batter into a hot lightly oiled pan and swirl thin, crack an egg on top and spread it out. Sprinkle with sesame seed and spring onion.
Cook for 2 minutes until the egg is fully set, flip, then brush with hoisin and chilli oil.
Lay a crisp wrapper and coriander on one side, fold in the edges and roll into a wrap. Repeat for the second.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Savoury Soy Milk Tofu Scramble Bowls
recipes.summary: Soft tofu scrambled with turmeric, spring onion and chilli oil over warm rice.
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until the edges turn golden.
Stir in the turmeric, soy sauce and soy milk and cook for 3 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and steaming hot.
Divide the rice between bowls, top with the scramble, spring onion and fried shallots, and drizzle with the sesame oil and chilli oil.

recipes.title: Tamagoyaki Rolled Omelette Breakfast Plates
recipes.summary: Sweet-savoury layered rolled omelette with rice, pickles and nori.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky.
Beat the eggs with the mirin, soy sauce and sugar until just combined.
Brush a small non-stick pan with oil over medium-low heat and pour in a thin layer of egg. When just set but still glossy, roll it up to one side.
Brush the pan again, pour in more egg under the roll, cook until set and roll again. Repeat until the egg is used up.
Slice the omelette and serve with the rice, nori and pickles.
notes: Food safety: the omelette should be set all the way through with no runny egg. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Miso Grilled Salmon Breakfast Plates
recipes.summary: Miso-glazed salmon with steamed rice and a quick cucumber pickle.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky.
Mix the miso, mirin and soy sauce and spread over the salmon.
Grill the salmon skin side up for 8 minutes until caramelised and the flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
Toss the cucumber with the vinegar, sugar and sesame seed for 5 minutes.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the pickle.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when the flesh turns opaque and flakes with a fork. Breakfast. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Onigiri Breakfast Pairs with Sesame Egg
recipes.summary: Palm-sized rice balls wrapped in nori and filled with a sesame egg mixture.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky, then cool slightly.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are fully set, cool, then mash with the mayonnaise, soy sauce and sesame seed.
Wet your hands, salt them and press a handful of rice around a spoonful of egg into a triangle.
Wrap each onigiri with a strip of nori and serve.
notes: Food safety: the eggs are boiled until fully set. Keep refrigerated if not eaten within an hour. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Shaobing Sesame Flatbread Egg Sandwiches
recipes.summary: Flaky sesame flatbreads filled with a scrambled egg, spring onion and chilli sauce.
steps: Knead the flour, water and salt for 6 minutes until smooth, then rest. Divide into 4 balls and roll out thin.
Brush with 1 tbsp oil, roll up, coil and flatten into discs, then press one side into the sesame seed.
Pan-fry the discs in a dry pan over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until golden and puffed.
Scramble the eggs with the spring onion and soy sauce in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until fully set.
Split each flatbread, fill with the egg and a spoonful of chilli sauce, and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set. Plus 30 minutes resting the dough. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Nori Cheese Omelette Toast
recipes.summary: A savoury folded omelette with nori and melted cheese in toasted bread.
steps: Beat the eggs with the soy sauce and spring onion.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat, pour in the egg and scatter with the nori and cheese.
Cook for 3 minutes until the egg is fully set and the cheese has melted, then fold in four.
Toast the bread until golden and sandwich the omelette between the slices.
notes: Food safety: cook the omelette until fully set. Breakfast. Vegetarian.
